notes: Metrics are calculated directly from the supplied cycle-level predictions.
Lower MAE and RMSE values indicate lower SOH prediction error.
The proposed method is not expected to outperform local-only training for every client.
Global FL metrics and client validation metrics are loaded from the supplied training_history.csv.
The replay timeline is aligned to the user dashboard battery-cycle timeline for presentation.
Communication progress is a deterministic visualization because network transport logs were not supplied.
Battery cycles are used as the presentation clock and are not Global FL Rounds.
The first 480 frames replay 20 Global FL Rounds. The final 24 frames replay personalized fine-tuning.
Upload, aggregation and broadcast percentages are deterministic presentation values.
